name: Fallon Henley
profileSummary: Theresa Schuessler is an American professional wrestler. As of 2022, she is signed to WWE, where she performs on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Fallon Henley. She is a member of the Fatal Influence stable and is one-half of the reigning WWE Women's Tag Team Championship alongside her stablemate Lainey Reid in their first reign. She is a former one-time NXT Women's North American Champion, a one-time WWE Women's Speed Champion, and a one-time NXT Women's Tag Team Champion.
